standing_hypotheses: Transitive string C-group G<=A_n, n>=12; every maximal omission intransitive.
Unique eligible i-edge with endpoints in the two G_i-orbits A,B.
Maximal block systems (block size,number)=(k,2),(2,m),m>=3, hence primitive block images.
M is minimal among the distinguished simultaneous block generators; actual-orbit deficits alpha0,beta1,gamma0 imply |M|=m,r=k+m.
claims: Pure C2 and maximal anchored S_m intervals in the block image, proved without quotient IP.
If the deficit is a four-point orbit in A, its support contains the anchor and H has a proved pure diagonal C2 kernel element; this support is G_i-invariant.
If the deficit lies in B, H_B is explicitly treated as transitive or as two natural copies. There is no outer right generator; left equality yields parity or a transitive global maximal omission.
Together with the paid complete predecessor cases: r<=floor((n-1)/2) when both G_i-orbit actions are imprimitive in the standing unique-crossing setting.
